summary_claims.claim: General objective: use AI for sustainable development and inclusive growth through ethical, responsible, safe, critical, creative and pro-innovation development
Line 1.2 calls for risk-based regulation, a national analysis of unacceptable uses with possible prohibitions or moratoria, audit frameworks and sandboxes

scope.note: National AI strategy whose first objective is a governance framework; extractor's scope_note is reasonable.

note: The 59-page strategy itself is stored and supports the summary; the AGESIC page supports title, 22 Nov 2024 publication and the committee's 21 Nov 2024 approval. Search found no replacement or update; Decree 276/025 regulating art. 74 of Law 20.212 is raised as a lead by the extractor and is not a new strategy.
